itemList.description:
Work of servicing, leak arresting and oil filtration upto 400 KVA power transformers as specified below: a.    Removing cable connection of transformer after isolating the supply dismantling the cable connection
b.   Replacing the existing leakage L.V side H.T Busing Gasket, oil seal, bots and nuts etc. of the power transformer.  c.   Replacing the existing non-functioned damaged Dehydrating Breather by a new breather with new silica gel for the above transformer  d.   Arresting oil leak from exclusive vent, neutral bushing of valves, flanges, is drying arresting the leakage for L.V and HV side of power transformer and refilling of the transformer oil including cost of labour and necessary repaired materials.
e.  Repaint the Transformer using light grey epoxy paint of 2 coated as original. f.  Filtering of oil in the transformer at the transformer center by hot process using stream line filter such that the dielectric strength of oil in the transformer conforms to ISI specification.  g.  Painting of entire structure of transformer yard including fencing using silver paint.

Overhauling and servicing of Double Pole Structure 6Mtr and above housing the sets of LA, GOS, HG Fuse etc. Servicing of GOS by opening the GOS. Check the gap between fixed contact and moving contact and also any pitting on the surface. Replacing the fixed and moving contact and the worn out or rusted parts, contacts, springs, bolts and nuts in the contact arrangement. Adjust the spring tension in the fixed contact to avoid loose contact between fixed and moving contacts. Adjust the arcing arm in the GOS and apply petroleum jelly for both contacts. Replacing the HG Fuse unit and fuse link and refixing using existing/new clamps, nuts and bolts etc. Removing and refixing/replacing the Lightning Arrestor, checking and fastening of earth strip properly to the structure Removing and replacing the rabbit ACSR conductors, jointing using PG Clamps and binding them wherever required as per standard practice Removing and replacing PVC alkathine tubes to the three phase jumps. Welding, grinding and cutting the MS beams wherever required. After service of the entire structure, loose connections, spark or loud hissing noise are not to be observed The entire work should be taken up after taking necessary clearances from ESCOM and all the three phases at the main incomer are earthed properly using three separate earthing/grounding rods. Consider 3 nos. of DP structure

Overhauling and servicing of 415V, 3-Phase, LT AC Distribution Panel Board up to 400Amps. The job includes Isolating the panel from power supply, cleaning required parts from dust and rust using sand paper, cotton waste etc. Complete electrical check Jup of MCCB, MCB, SFU, HRC and calibration of meters etc. must be done and if necessary replace electrical wiring, contactors, MCBs, main power cable (armoured), meters, CT, LED Indicators, push buttons etc. Cutting, drilling additional holes and Job modifying the panel for any housing of meters/equipments and welding if necessary etc. Replacement of limit switches, relays, multifunction meter if necessary. After completion of work the panel must be throughly working with perfect operation of switchgears, relays, meters and indicating lamps.

Conducting, preparing and furnishing the results of earth test, transformer oil test and insulation testing as per the requirements of CEA MSES Regulations, 2010. Earth test of all earth electrodes must be conducted by disconnecting earth leads from individual electrodes during dry day of a dry season. Insulation test of all equipments and between conductors and earth of all HT and LT circuits must be conducted. Transformer Job oil test furnishing the results of acidity, specific resistance, tan delta, BDV etc. All the required results must furnished and any deviation from the standard accepted values must be rectified in compliance with Govt Electrical Inspectorate norms.

Supply and installation of Galvanised steel chequered plate with nominal dimensions of 0.6 meters x 0.6 meters and 3mm thickness, Base Material: The base steel shall conform to the requirements of an approved standard grade such as IS 2062 Grade E 250A, IS 3502, ASTM A36, or S235JR, as agreed upon by the purchaser and manufacturer Galvanisation Standard: The galvanisation process and the resulting zinc coating shall conform to international standards such as ASTM A123, BS EN ISO 1461, or IS 4759/6745, Chequer Pattern: The plate shall have a raised pattern (e.g., diamond or Sam teardrop/lentil pattern) for anti-skid purposes.
